Introduction
============

This software provides a simple and efficient method for determining the dry mass of a single cell using the 
Transport of Intensity Equation (TIE). The process requires only a stack of images captured with a widefield 
microscope.

Two different approaches are implemented to solve the TIE: the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) method and the 
Total Variation (TV) Regularization method. Additionally, contour detection is included to calculate the 
area of a cell.

In summary, this tool offers methods to determine both the dry mass and the area of a cell.
